card.name: Word endings before a following noun
card.fires_on: The last piece of a compound or split word that directly modifies the next noun, such as 'resealable' before 'medication port' or 'cube' before 'trays'. It is strongest in IV-bag instructions and craft or lab supply lists.

modes.label: Resealable port
modes.description: The ending 'able' of 'resealable' before medication or additive port in injection steps.
modes.example: Using syringe with 19 to 22 gauge needle, puncture reseal<<able>> medication port and inject.

modes.label: Item-name modifier
modes.description: The final part of a compound modifier that sits before a container or object noun.
modes.example: Cups or ice<< cube>> trays for mixing colors

modes.label: Brand or vial name
modes.description: The end of a split product or container word.
modes.example: Discard any unused HEMLIBRA remaining in the single-d<<ose>> vial.
